title: Xbox Helix reportedly planned Steam and free online 🎮
subject: projecthelix
description:
Would free online have sold you on Helix? 👇

Windows Central's Jez Corden reports, citing sources close to Microsoft, that Xbox Project Helix was first planned as a full gaming PC with Steam and other PC stores, and with no paywall for online multiplayer. The report says new management and rising component costs may change that. Microsoft has not confirmed the report.

Sources: Windows Central (Nov 23, 2026), Pure Xbox (Nov 23, 2026)

scenes.text: The next Xbox was reportedly built to run Steam.
scenes.search: gaming console glowing green light dark

scenes.text: On November 23, Windows Central's Jez Corden reported Project Helix's original plan, citing sources close to Microsoft.
It was going to be a full gaming PC, with console games on top and Steam built in.
Online multiplayer would have been free, with no paywall.
That plan came under Phil Spencer and Sarah Bond. Both are gone, and component prices keep rising.
Xbox now calls Helix a console first. Microsoft hasn't confirmed the report.
